title: the Readiness tab renders question cards grouped by source span
description: User story under REQ-180, reserved by DEFINE step 3 spec section 11.8 and authored here by the viewer UI refresh PR 8. The Readiness tab leads with the product owner's three questions in plain words: two VerdictCards from `levels` (Ready for engineers, Ready to build, each with its chain term `intent-complete` or `ready-to-build` muted beside the plain label; both cards rendered at equal height), QuestionCards grouped by source span (one group per blocker; one card per failing item, phrasebook-sourced today, swapping to `readiness.questions[]` when DEFINE step 3 PR 2 ships `computeQuestions`), a what-happens-next paragraph, and a Requirements that still need work table. Every engineer-level finding stays on the page one level down in one collapsed `For engineers` DocRow (closed in the productOwner register, open in engineer; never removed from the DOM). The adapter seam `toQuestions(readiness)` is a pure module reading blockers today and feature-detecting `readiness.questions` tomorrow.
asA: a product owner opening the Readiness tab
iWant: the questions waiting on me in plain words, grouped by their source span, without ids or stage codes
soThat: I can answer them in my own session and see the hand-over state update as I go

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] given questions[] non-empty, when the tab renders, then the block lists each group with its asks and every id is in the JSON.
[failure] given questions[] empty, when the tab renders, then the block shows the intent-complete verdict line.
[must-not] given any register, when the tab renders, then the engineer blockers are not removed from the DOM.
